title: Luscious Dense Filipino Fish Lumpia Bake
description: A citrusy and dense Filipino dish featuring unflavored gelatin, perfect for special occasions, this pescatarian-friendly lumpia bake is a show-stopper at any gathering.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the fish fillets, gelatin, lemon juice, garlic, onion, fish sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Stir in the egg until everything is well combined.
Lay a lumpia wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the fish mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little bit of water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal the lumpia.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Place the lumpia in a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Garnish with lemon wedges if desired.
